title: Assessment
description: Assessment of a measured value (D-20, D-21). Display category, not an official warning level.

origin.description: source = classification by the source, display = own display threshold

sourceValue.description: original level of the source, e.g. BAFU level 3 or eHYD code 410 (D-21)

previous.description: Last assessment before the measured value became stale (B-01)
